title: Pizza Hut: 100% Cashback (One Transaction Only, Capped at $9 per Member) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Pizza Hut: 100% Cashback (One Transaction Only, Capped at $9 per Member) @ TopCashback AU

[I Smell Pennies] All 6 family accounts tracked fast thanks again TCB/TA 🍻
[Charity] Which pizzas and code combos to maximise this deal?
[jchin1408] Does this code not void the HUT codes only requirement?
[Usemame] Not a real code. It's tuesday 2 for 1 deal that's worth.
[JHoliday] Any HUT codes still valid? Did they can the 30% off one?
[knobbs] Nope they basically canned all codes because Dominos did it. They want to offer 'quality' instead of cheap pizza. Looks to me like they just stopped the codes and didn't change anything else
[JHoliday] What about $1 Wednesday wings? Is that gone too?
[ironworthy] This wed wings deal was the only thing worth it at ph
[SkyeMG] wait what dominos no more coupons ??
gone r the days of coupons??
bring back $5 value pizzas dominos 😭
[nicholasv] Always love meeting someone when it is their first day on earth:
Cashback is eligible on pickup and delivery orders, including PRE-ORDERS (Tuesday)
Aww why did you change your comment. I much prefer your previous one of "only valid for TODAY (Sunday)"
[Randolph Duke] @nicholasv: Imagine thinking been able to pre-order Pizza Hut was common knowledge, even on OzBargain.
[Hvrd] But I’m hungry now :( , but nah I just wanted to make people aware before doing the whole order
[Craze] Just got the app notification and came here to double confirm. Thanks TA!
[Captain Hindsight] If your spending more then SB has $10 CB https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/977634
[amsaini15] We don't know 2for1 works on SB or not. Zero support from SB.
[baj] Would it track if I put an advance order for Tuesday using 2 for 1 Tuesdays offer?
[Crayze w00kie] What's the best way to take advantage of this deal? Cheapest pizzas are $15 with a $9 maximum cashback
[mitt] Set the pickup time for your order to sometime Tuesday & use the 2 for 1 tuesday deal. You start your order, edit the pickup day, then the 2 for 1 deal will appear on the deals page.
That or order one of their "personal" pizza combos for around $9. The personal pizzas are pretty sad though. They really skimp on toppings for them so its mostly bread.
[8refund] could you please let me know where and how to order "personal" pizza combos for around $9"?
[mickeyk] Cheapest pizzas are $11.45 (Pepperoni Lovers, Ham Lovers, etc) - you get 1 pizza for $2.45
Two for one, you'd have to spend $16.45 - which means you would pay $5 for your 2nd pizza compared to the first option
Hershey's Brownie ($10.95 - 9270kj) is an interesting option if you like desserts
[tyvod] Preordered two pizzas on Tuesday using BOGOF deal and used NAB offer to get extra $5 off (spend $20 get $5 back).
$20.9 - $9 topcashback - $5 nab = $6.9 for two supremes with one stuffed crust.
Tbh, this is not as good as the previous 100% cashback deals when HUT codes were around.. 🥲
[Slo20] Damn. I wish I saw this comment 10 mins ago. I only just switched to NAB credit card so didn’t even think of the goodies deals.
No idea why someone negged you for helping others.
[bargain_knight] Note you would have got an extra $1 back with shopback
[s0805] Hmmm…how did you make your bill $20 with 2 for on1 offer? I am looking to stack both offers as well.
[tyvod] add the stuffed crust option (+$3.95) on one of your pizzas
[s0805] good idea. that would stop me paying crazy price for sides…lol
[BinnyC] Do you have to just pay with NAB card or activate something first in NAB goodies link?
[deekay91] Activate the deal first in the goodies section and pay using a NAB card
[BinnyC] Can I use my topcashback account with wife NAB card goodies link activated ?
[digitale] Is that targeted or maybe expired? When I clicked on "Go to Deal", there's no Pizza Hut.
I also can't find it in my NAB app.
[Owgasm] Thank you!
$20.40 - $9 - $5 for us for Tuesday!
[stussy1992] Went for the wings and was disappointed to see its not available anymore.
[markwid] Anyone seeing the login code server not working? Not receiving the code via email or sms.
[Craze] Haven't ordered Pizza Hut in a while- did they do away with $1 wings on Wednesday? I'm setting pre order for Wed and don't see th deal.
[Big-Deal] Only see on app but app orders are not eligible so trying to see if I can somehow get it over to browser cart
[bcYield] Cooking at home is healthier and more manageable. But thanks for sharing.
[UFO] How is it 100% when capped to $9? Pizza hut has nothing for $9 do they?
[sintro] I can only see a $9.95 lunch deal with wings
[Rrpnothanx] If ordering tonight… 1x large pizza, 1x 1.25L drink, + garlic bread at $25.01. Less $9 cashback $16.01 pickup. Hrmmm…. thinking 🤔
[plmko] Not that great of a deal unless desparate. Just saying.
[aldog] Did this deal using ShopBack’s $10 off and then used TopCashback for a Hershey’s cookie 🍪
[sintro] There is labour day surcharge tomorrow.
Personal pan lunch deal with half garlic bread is $7.95 + holiday surcharge is $9.14 total.
[plmko] Surcharge is not counted as cashback. So you will not get 100%
[nofuel8111] Anyone get tracking? I havent got mine yet. Its been 30 minutes
[ironworthy] Yep tracked within 15 mins. The last time it didn't track for me so had to make claim
[Craze] Mmm hasn't tracked for me, ordered few hours ago. No issues previously. Hopefully will go through ok
[USER DC] Thanks TA, just hate that pizza hut make everything good OOS on website on local stores.
[highwind] Order tracked after 9 mins ($9) - ordering for Tuesday pick-up
[Charlie Dont Surf] Ordered: 16:42
Tracked: 16:52
TCB/Pizza Hut tracking success rate: 100.00%
[Charlie Dont Surf] Just a dessert using TCB, and BOGOF pizzas on SB.
[Ozbargainasaurus] Don't need codes for 2 for Tuesday anymore….
[Profitser] Trying to order, stuck in a loop:
We're sorry, <store> is not currently open for Delivery and Pick Up. You can place an advance order for Tomorrow!
Click on Advance order now > Select future date > Continue your Order:
Delivery unavailable: Sorry, we do not deliver to the address you entered. You may be able to pick up your order from a nearby store. > Select "Switch to Pickup"
Loops back to step 1
[Zxie8] Cheapest pizzas – change the pickup date to a weekday, choose pizzas such as Pepperoni Lovers and Ham Lovers, and change the size to medium - $9.95
[ja912son] Thanks TA. $2.45 for a large basic pizza is pretty good.
[StarkZone] Expired ! I thought it said 11.59 pm tonight ?
[shortgum] bought one transaction total of $8.90 at about 9:38pm until now still not tracked
